An '''IG-100 MagnaGuard''' was stationed in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] around the time of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|mission]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Tethan">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We will never yield, prepare to DIE!|The IG-100 MagnaGuard, to a [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|Tethan Human youngling]] in one adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
